name: GetKpiByProduct
description: Get KPI metrics per product/material from SAP: quantity sold, revenue, delivery fulfillment rate. Trigger when user asks about product performance, best-selling items, or per-SKU revenue analysis. All params optional.

materialIdOrName.description: Material ID or partial product name. Null to return all products.

fromDate.description: Start date YYYY-MM-DD. Null if not specified.

toDate.description: End date YYYY-MM-DD. Null if not specified.

top.description: Return top N products by quantity or revenue. Null if not specified.
